name: Scratch Gift
summary: A ribbon-wrapped gift card with a real scratch-off strip and a 12-character redeem field
about: A plum and coral gift card with a mint ribbon and a silver scratch strip you can rub off with your mouse or finger. The code goes into three groups of four that behave like one field, and a right code flips the card, counts up the value and sends a coin into your wallet balance. Good for gift cards, vouchers and store credit pages.
how: Scratch the silver strip (or press Reveal it for me) to uncover the 12-character code
Type or paste it into the three boxes; the caret moves across them, and backspace and arrows cross the gaps
Press Redeem: the card leans back while the groups are checked
A right code flips the card, counts up the amount, flies a coin to the wallet and bursts ribbons
A wrong or already-used code shakes the boxes in red; Redeem another card slides in a new one
